narrative.value_prop: Search case law publicly and, with a CourtListener token, build bounded docket briefs, relationship maps, filing watches, and RECAP availability audits.

quickstart.comment: Run a bounded public case-law search.
Create or compare a bounded public search observation.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for sourced case-law and RECAP metadata research where incomplete archive coverage is disclosed.
anti_triggers: Do not predict case outcomes or score judges.
Do not imply RECAP covers every PACER filing.
Do not automate paid PACER retrieval.
